name: 流式审核抽检 — 审核节点抽检配置项验证
description: 验证审核节点管理页面中，流式抽检相关配置项（抽检开关、比例、抽检人、样本来源）的展示与编辑。

steps.description: 打开审核节点管理页面
验证审核节点管理页面已加载

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const hasInspection = text.includes('检查设置') || text.includes('抽检') || text.includes('质检'); const editBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, span')).filter(e => e.textContent.trim() === '编辑'); return { hasInspectionConfig: hasInspection, editButtonCount: editBtns.length, pagePreview: text.substring(0, 500) }; })()
steps.description: 验证审核节点列表含检查设置/抽检配置

steps.expression: (() => { const editBtns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button, a, span')).filter(e => e.textContent.trim() === '编辑'); if (editBtns[0]) { editBtns[0].click(); return { clicked: true }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击编辑按钮查看节点配置

steps.expression: (() => { const text = document.body.innerText; const configItems = { inspectionSwitch: text.includes('抽检') || text.includes('检查'), inspectionRatio: text.includes('比例') || text.includes('抽检任务比例'), inspectionPerson: text.includes('抽检人') || text.includes('参与人'), sampleSource: text.includes('样本来源') || text.includes('抽检样本') }; return { configItems, pagePreview: text.substring(0, 800) }; })()
steps.description: 验证节点配置含抽检相关配置项

_testDesign.preconditions: F88预发环境可访问；审核节点管理页面有可编辑的审核节点
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.打开审核节点管理 2.验证列表含检查设置 3.点击编辑 4.验证配置项
_testDesign.expectedResult: 审核节点编辑页含抽检开关、抽检比例、抽检人、样本来源等配置
riskPoints: 编辑操作可能弹窗或跳转新页面
relatedDocs: Aone#84266820 PRD - 配置项生效逻辑
